known_issues: benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-competitive-release-regressions-easy/tests/verify.py:267-284: a suite is all-or-nothing. Any "[SM] Exception reported", "Native is not bound" or "Plugin ... failed to load" line in the server log, a missing FINAL marker or a duplicate case turns EVERY case of that suite into a failure, including preserved guards and the load sentinel. A target defect that throws therefore also fails preserved cases of the same suite; read per-case outcomes of a failing suite with that in mind.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-competitive-release-regressions-easy/tests/suite_change_partial.sp:134-143: when the first partial name times out, the second-partial and Director cases are emitted as FAIL without having been exercised (dependent cases, not independent evidence).

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-competitive-release-regressions-easy/tests/suite_change_transition.sp:41-42 reads CDirector::m_isTransitioning from the SUBMITTED gamedata file l4d2_fix_changelevel.txt (verify.py:181-182 copies it from the submission). The maintainer NOTES.md records that upstream's own repair (GetMapDisplayName) does not resolve c1m2 on the pinned Linux runtime; only FindMap-based resolution is known to satisfy CR-126 here. This narrows the space of accepted implementations but follows from engine behavior, not from an assertion.
